name: arohi-by-megha
description: Arohi by Megha - MERN e-commerce monorepo (client storefront, admin dashboard, Express/MongoDB API)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.postinstall: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public/admin && cp -r client/dist/. public/ && cp -r admin/dist/. public/admin/
